synopsis: The EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC applies until 19 January 2027, and Machinery Regulation 2023/1230, adopted on 14 June 2023, applies from 20 January 2027 [f2744, f2747]. For products sold in the EU after 20 January 2027 whose safety function is performed by machine learning, expert advice is to plan for notified-body engagement under Annex I Part A unless legal advice concludes otherwise [f2643]. For those products, expert advice also anticipates machinery-specific AI requirements by 2 August 2028 [f2644]. Separately, the glossary warns that simulation traceability and archived safety-case records may be disclosed in court under the new EU product liability rules, making record retention relevant beyond regulatory acceptance [f12201].

relations.note: Regulation commencement completes the timeline established by the Directive's final applicability date.
Notified-body planning uses the Regulation's applicability date as its sales threshold.
AI requirements advice targets products sold after the Regulation becomes applicable.
Adds a later AI requirements milestone for the same machine-learning safety-function products.
